DECLARES NO DEPENDENCY ON PURPOSE - a measurement fixture, not a mod to play with.
It replaces one shipped Acidworm texture with a magenta checker. Every other demo declares "Dependencies": [ "com.morgott.ContentTool" ]; this one declares none, so ticking it on does NOT switch ContentTool on. With ContentTool off it does nothing at all and says nothing at all. See docs\SHIPPING-A-CONTENT-MOD.md for the measured result.
